method: RDKit MolFromSequence, explicit H, ETKDGv3 seed 42, one conformer, MMFF94 max 1000 iterations
chemistry: linear L sequence, uncapped N+ and C-, Asp-, neutral histidine; no solvent or receptor
limitations: One stochastic conformer, not a validated prediction of the free peptide ensemble.
No receptor, docking, binding, affinity, or experimental validation.
Fixed protonation and vacuum force field; no solvent or sampling of alternatives.
